artworks.title: Roowaensche Quay (De Roowaensche Kaey)
artworks.description: The image displays a canal scene from an elevated viewpoint. A row of trees and structures lines the horizon, with a notable church tower featuring a clock and a spire. The sketch is detailed and intricate, showcasing precise lines and cross-hatching for texture and depth. The color scheme consists of black and gray shades, emphasizing the water, sky, ships, and masts. Ships with tall masts, flags, and smaller boats populate the canal. A person rows a boat nearby. A stone bridge, pedestrians, and buildings are visible in the distance, forming a lively cityscape. The sky is depicted with cloud formations using fine line work.

artworks.title: The Ferry to Utrecht (Het veer van der Uytersche schiet-schuyten)
artworks.description: The image shows a canal scene with sailboats moored along a dock. Trees line the horizon, with city structures in the distance. The detailed etching style highlights the foliage, architecture, and water. The black and white color palette accentuates the intricate lines.

artworks.title: Appelmarkt (De Appelmarckt)
artworks.description: The image shows a harbor with boats docked along the water's edge. Figures are visible on the boats, suggesting activity. In the middle ground, there are wooden structures and foliage leading to a church steeple in the distance. The horizon is situated about one-third from the bottom of the image. The scene is depicted with intricate line work creating textures like ripples in the water and leaves on trees. The color palette is monochromatic, using ink on paper for contrast.

artworks.title: The Ferry to Leiden (Het Leytsche veer)
artworks.description: The image shows a canal with sailboats on the left, featuring tall masts and sails with flags. Buildings line the water's edge with gabled roofs and ornate details. The artwork uses detailed etching-style brushstrokes in a monochromatic palette of black and gray. Additional buildings, trees, and small figures can be seen in the background, and the water reflects the surroundings.

artworks.title: The Ferry to Naarden (Het Naerder veer)
artworks.description: The image shows a canal with a bridge in the distance. Tall buildings and trees line the horizon, with a cloudy sky above. The scene is rendered in black and white with detailed textures. Boats are moored on the left, and there are larger boats near the bridge. Stately buildings with detailed roofs are on the right.

artworks.title: Footit and Chocolat (Footit et Chocolat)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene showing a clown or performer interacting with a bull. The sketch is done energetically with quick and expressive lines. On the left side, a clown in elaborate clothing appears startled, leaning backward with raised hands. In the center, another figure is in motion. On the right, a bull is partially shown, moving out of the scene. The background includes lightly sketched indications of a crowd, conveying a sense of action and spontaneity.

artworks.title: La valse des lapins
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on japan paper
artworks.description: This image features a group of rabbits. One rabbit is close to the viewer, shown resting and eating vegetation. The brushwork consists of delicate lines and a stippled texture. In the background, another rabbit stands in front of a bright circular shape that may represent the sun or moon. The horizon line is low, highlighting the sky and distant landscape. The color scheme is predominantly black and gray, contrasting with the off-white paper. The title "La Valse des Lapins" is displayed at the top of the image.

artworks.title: The Submersion of Pharoah's Army in the Red Sea
artworks.description: The image shows a scene captured from a slightly elevated point of view, displaying both land and sea. The horizon is high in the composition, where the sea meets a distant cityscape with spires and towers. The brushstrokes, in this woodcut technique, are meticulous and dense, creating texture and depth in the swirling waters and skies. The color palette is stark, as seen in black and white prints, using shadows and highlights to convey the dramatic scene. Figures and horses are in motion in the foreground, depicting a battlefield. Waves dominate a large portion leading to a calm skyline while cliffs rise to the side. The composition is dynamic, busy, and intricate.

artworks.title: Two Girls in a Landscape
artworks.medium: graphite and black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a black and white drawing of two figures in a natural setting. One person stands with their hands folded in front of them, wearing a dark coat over a light garment. The other person sits on the ground with legs tucked to the side, wearing a light dress. They are positioned against a large tree in a forest landscape.

artworks.title: Draped Figure, Standing
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright with a slight lean to their right. Their head is bowed, looking downwards, with their right hand resting against the side of their face. The person's facial features are not clearly defined. They have short, wavy hair, partly covered with a head covering. They are wearing a loose, flowing garment that covers them from head to toe, with bare feet partially hidden. There are no visible accessories or objects in their hands. The background is a plain, light-colored canvas with subtle orange shading.

artworks.title: Red House, Paimpol
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a three-story building with intricate architectural details, viewed from a street-level perspective. The building has a steeply pitched roof, timber-framed facade, and an array of windows. The focus is on the building itself, and the linework is delicate and sketch-like with a mix of fine and slightly broader strokes. The color palette is limited, primarily using a subdued reddish hue combined with black against a warm beige paper background. The sketch includes faintly drawn figures and outlines of adjacent structures, suggesting a street scene with minimal detail beyond the main building.

artworks.title: Yellow House, Lannion
artworks.description: This print shows the front of a building with a sloping roof. The roof is gray with some areas of yellow ochre, perhaps indicating piles of leaves. The building has several windows and window shades, all colored in pale green. There appear to be three stories in the building, with faint vertical lines of lilac bricks or stones on the left and right and an arched opening in the bottom left. Two figures in hats and skirts stand in the bottom left corner, facing the building. The background of the print is yellow-beige paper, and the lines are soft and sketch-like.

artworks.title: Weary
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of a person focusing on their upper body. The figure is reclining horizontally with their head slightly elevated. The facial features are delicately drawn with a soft profile and eyes looking upwards. The hair is wavy and cascades around the head. The person is wearing a long-sleeved garment with flowing lines. The background consists of diagonal and horizontal lines for texture. No jewelry or additional objects are present in the image.

artworks.title: Draped Figure, Reclining
artworks.description: The image shows a person reclined on a sofa or bed. They are positioned with their body slightly propped up against the backrest, legs bent at the knees. Their head rests against a pillow or cushion, and they have short, curly hair. The person is wearing a loose-fitting light-colored garment and holds a small polka-dot pillow or fabric in their hand. The background features minimalistic details of a wall and indistinct shapes, with a focus on the person and a couple of pillows.

artworks.title: Eve
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length view of a nude woman standing. She is positioned in a slight contrapposto, with her right arm extended to the side and her left hand holding a small round object by her shoulder. The woman has long, flowing hair with gentle waves that cascade down her back, and her facial features are rendered in a classical style with a calm expression. She is surrounded by a landscape that includes a large tree with twisted roots to her left, from which a snake is emerging. In the background, to the right, there is a rugged rocky formation and a bull with prominent horns feeding on the ground.

artworks.title: Head of a Roman Emperor
artworks.description: The image shows a profile view of a person's head and shoulders within a circular frame, facing right. The head is angled slightly forward with a prominent nose and firm jawline. The person's hair is styled with wavy locks adorned with laurel leaves, and they wear a draped garment covering the shoulders. There are no visible accessories. The artwork is a monochromatic print on a textured surface, potentially depicting a historical or allegorical figure. The background has a simple, grainy texture.

artworks.title: Saint Cecilia
artworks.artist: Attributed to Antonio da Trento after Parmigianino
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a person seen from the waist up in profile. The person is positioned at the center with arms outstretched and is depicted with delicate facial features, styled hair, and flowing garments. Two smaller figures are near the central person, potentially cherubs, also interacting with the garments or a large object. The background is minimalistic with textural lines and shading, enhancing the focus on the central figures within the circular frame.

artworks.title: Los Supporting the Sun [recto]
artworks.description: The image is an abstract pencil sketch of a person standing with legs wide apart and arms raised overhead. The person is holding a circular or crescent-shaped object above their head. The facial features are rough with large, prominent eyes and a focused expression. The hair is depicted with lines radiating outward. The person appears unclothed, with sketch lines hinting at body contours. The background is filled with swirling, zigzag lines, possibly indicating movement or energy.

artworks.title: A Crouching Figure Holding a Shield [verso]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an abstract form containing sweeping lines and organic shapes. The drawing consists of pencil lines on a textured paper. The central feature is elongated and looped, with curved lines. There is a sense of movement and the figure is surrounded by additional rounded shapes. The drawing occupies most of the paper with a few vertical and horizontal lines framing the figure. The overall composition appears to capture a dynamic pose.

artworks.title: Good Human Qualities
artworks.description: The image consists of twelve small, rectangular illustrations arranged in three rows and four columns on a single sheet. Each illustration features different scenes of people primarily presented in full-body views. The scenes are presented in delicate, detailed sketches. In the top row, the illustrations are placed upside down, depicting various figures including standing individuals and a couple embracing. These figures appear in classical robes and are placed against a backdrop of outdoor landscapes, with trees and natural elements like clouds or shrubs. Most figures are static, though one appears engaged in interaction. Some illustrations have inscriptions above or below the images. The bottom row features additional scenes, one depicting a seated figure engaging with a child, others standing solo in classic poses. One image shows a figure holding a helmet or circular object. The setting remains consistent across the sheet with minimal backgrounds, often including simple foliage. The structured and symmetrical layout suggests a formal or narrative purpose, with each panel contributing to a larger series or theme.

artworks.title: Illustrations to Fables & Tales by Gellert, Gleim, Hagedorn, Lichtwer and Pfeffel
artworks.description: This is a series of twelve rectangular illustrations in a monochromatic style, resembling etchings or engravings. Each scene is labeled and numbered. The top row features a horse and rider, a man climbing a vine, two figures on a path, two figures under a canopy, and figures near architecture. The bottom row includes a woman in a field, men around a seated person, a crow and a fox, figures near a well, a somber interior, and a figure in the woods. The labels suggest a narrative or moral connection between the scenes, possibly inspired by folktales or fables.

artworks.title: Saint George Standing
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythical warrior standing in elaborate armor in a fantastical landscape. The warrior wears detailed armor with engravings and a plumed helmet. A bird motif is prominent on the chest plate. In the background are lush foliage and a decorative architectural wall. Below the warrior are serpents and mythical creatures. The image is rendered in a detailed, linear style typical of engravings from the Renaissance period, with cross-hatching and attention to texture and form.

artworks.title: Two Fauns Carrying a Child
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two men and a child with rustic elements. The scene depicts two muscular men, one on each side, appearing to support a basket or platform that holds a young child. The figure on the left is holding a club, while the figure on the right wields a torch. Both figures are partially draped with cloth, emphasizing their physique. The child is central in the composition, with an intent expression. The background features a fabric or tapestry that adds depth and detail, and the edges of the drawing include decorative elements such as tree branches and foliage. The style is reminiscent of classical or mythological themes, often associated with Renaissance art, reflecting an emphasis on anatomy and narrative.

artworks.title: Two Shepherds and a Boy
artworks.medium: color chiaroscuro woodcut on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of three figures in a dynamic interaction, set against an ancient arched structure. The central figure holds a lifeless figure, while another kneels next to them. The background features stylized arches and pillars. The color palette consists of earthy tones and shades of grey, in the Baroque style emphasizing strong contrast and emotive expression.
